say:1:1710335001:1.text: I feel sorry for the Young Master...
say:1:1710335001:1.source_cn: 看着罗万少爷这样子，心里真不好受啊……

say:2:1710335002:1.text: What do you mean? He seems perfectly fine to me.
say:2:1710335002:1.source_cn: 罗万少爷怎么了？我没看出有什么变化啊。

say:3:1710335003:1.text: He rallied the whole Consortium to investigate the Hall of Ancients' disappearance. How can you be so insensitive?
say:3:1710335003:1.source_cn: 商会的人都接到了协查圣古堂消失的通知，这还叫没什么事啊？

say:4:1710335004:1.text: Um... isn't he just doing it to curry favor with the royal family?
say:4:1710335004:1.source_cn: 呃……这是做给王室看的吧？

say:5:1710335005:1.text: How could that be? He's obviously worried sick about Princess Peggy. I've never heard him sigh this much in a single day!
say:5:1710335005:1.source_cn: 怎么可能！罗万少爷分明很上心，他今天叹气的次数比往常的...

say:6:1710335006:1.text: Isn't he on bad terms with the princess? You know, he ran away from their engagement ceremony...
say:6:1710335006:1.source_cn: 罗万少爷不是和佩吉公主关系很差吗？之前逃婚那件事……

say:7:1710335007:1.text: Shush, that's all in the past. Don't bring it up again!
say:7:1710335007:1.source_cn: 嘘，那都是什么时候的事了，别再提了！
